published.source: Tauren, Nature's Focus pushback and the client 70425 racials (2026-10-16)

summary: 41/0/10 moonkin that keeps Insect Swarm and Moonfire up and weaves Wrath and Starfire to spend every Eclipse charge. It is the talent search's best on the synthetic Phase 1 gear and the default Balance Level 60 preset.
rotation: Pre-pull: Starfire (rank 6) cast 3 s before the pull so it lands at 0
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown (Innervate on its own trigger)
Insect Swarm whenever it is down (more than 8 s of fight left)
Moonfire whenever its dot is down (more than 8 s of fight left)
Starfire when Clearcasting is up (Wrath does not use it up)
Moonfire when a Starfire would not land before the end
Wrath when Eclipse is at 2 charges or fewer and no Wrath is in flight
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 36 spell power and 15 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
No Ahn'Qiraj ranks: Starfire rank 6 costs 13.3 DPS (820.4 -> 807.1 at 180 s, first gear)
5-piece Grovekeeper Eclipse instead of 2-piece would add 12.6 and Swarming Idol is worth 3.3 (measured before the 5a and 1b rounds)
At 300 s mana runs out and the plain weave without the Clearcasting Starfire is 2 ahead
Wrath VIII's base damage ×1.085, halfway to the level 30 rank's 0.42 of Era (only ranks 1 to 5 were retuned); the client has ×1.00
Omen of Clarity's proc chance on spells and Eclipse charges on Wrath landing are unverified
Only one +2% crit elixir by standard; a second (Owl) would add 15.1
notes: Request from mksettings -spec balance (caster group: Mana Spring, Kings + Wisdom, no Might, own Moonkin Form crit; 30 yd range; Innervate on self). Duration set to 180 s, durationVariation 20 as in EncounterLevel60. No edits needed.
